name: Maquiritari

ancestors.notes: Descent per Glottolog classification of Ye'kwana (maqu1238).

notes: Skeleton. Cariban language of the Venezuela-Brazil border region, self-named Ye'kwana (also Maquiritari), in its Spanish-influenced practical orthography. ch=[tʃ], j=[h], ñ=[ɲ], and the back/central unrounded vowels ö=[ɤ] and ü=[ɨ] are mapped; d denotes an implosive/flap [ɗ]. Contrastive vowel nasalization and predictable stress/length are not recovered from spelling and are left unencoded, raising the PER floor.

wikipron.measured: 0 of 1746 rows in the WikiPron mch_latn_narrow gold carry a nasalized vowel, and 286 write a doubled vowel. The same 1746 gold transcriptions carry a long vowel on 830 rows, no nasalization mark on any row, and no stress mark on any row. So the contrast this row's PER floor rests on is vowel length, written in 286 rows and transcribed in 830; the practical Spanish-influenced orthography this spec describes leaves it unencoded. Nasalization and stress are named in the spec notes but are not transcribed in this gold, so no count here supports them.
